form.title: RDDC registry to Phenopackets
form.description: A patient registry export (hierarchical JSON or wide CSV) in a deposited batch to GA4GH Phenopackets v2, with validation and subject reconciliation reports. The batch's sourceId must have a registered mapping (mappings/sources.yaml). Terms are resolved with the vocabulary subset in the pipeline's assets/.

strict_validation.title: Fail on validation errors
strict_validation.description: Fail the run if any phenopacket has a validation error.
